decision_basis: No existing Typebot project was supplied for reuse. Streamlit supports session state, deterministic graph traversal and source cards in a small implementation.
nickname_storage: Optional chat or interface name; session only; excluded from study-response downloads.
timezone: Browser-reported timezone by default, with explicit UTC fallback and optional manual override.
status: Local Streamlit application; guided study preview available; public deployment and formal evaluation pending.
review_readiness: Source-checked content supports the internal prototype. Record-level source review and pending per-edge operational review are tracked separately.
submission_requirements: Final Moodle upload must be PDF; see submission_requirements.json for the user-transcribed deadline and timezone limitation.
approval_basis: The author authorised proceeding provisionally while awaiting the lecturer’s actual response. This does not constitute lecturer approval or ethical clearance.
